Description:
Manually curated human colorectal cancer ExpressionSet
objects from 34 studies, with uniformly processed expression
data and standardized clinical metadata including survival
outcomes. Datasets are hosted on Zenodo and downloaded on first
use, then cached locally with BiocFileCache. Includes a
configurable script for rule-based creation of filtered dataset
lists for meta-analysis.

_commit.author: Levi Waldron <lwaldron.research@gmail.com>
_commit.message:
Integrity report: verify size_bytes, not just md5

R/getData.R compares size_bytes against the cached file on every cache
hit, so a wrong size in the manifest would silently evict and
re-download a valid file on every call, with no error. The integrity
report checked md5 only, and so was blind to the one field that drives
that behaviour. It now asserts size against both the local upload and
the Zenodo API.

The published manifest is correct: the strengthened report passes
against Zenodo record 23125734 unchanged. This closes the gap for future
regenerations.

Found by Copilot review on lima1/curatedBladderData#3, which carries the
same report.
